status: PROGRESS; whole production inference/vLLM parity objective remains ACTIVE and incomplete
component: Native DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 HC4 carried-pre mixing and residual application

api.geometry: R1..65535,D128..65536,D%4==0, CUDA SM80+; actually qualified R1/7/32/33/64/256,D5120, plus synthetic D128
api.weights: Existing shared immutable model/backend-owned RAW F32 fn[24,4D],base[1,24],scale[1,3]. No extra weight copies or cache.
api.state: Caller request-owned exact F32 streams[R,4,D], partials[R,chunks,25], post/pre_in/pre_out[R,4], comb[R,4,4], collapsed[R,D]. Empty all-zero pre_in means first site. All supplied views pairwise disjoint; carry reset at first site of each forward.
api.arithmetic: Original fixed partial/re-reduction order, vector4 FMA, approximate sigmoid/exp/rsqrt, warp Sinkhorn row/column normalization. Original fast-math flags confined to new CUDA translation unit. R<=32 F32 fn rounded RN to F16 and converted back on read; R>32 unrounded F32. Collapse stays F32. Apply accepts F16/F32 Y, multiplies post*Y then four sequential comb[g,h]*stream[g] FMAs.
api.validation: Shapes/counts/types/alignment, backend/raw-handle ownership, request/generation, finite positive epsilons, iterations1..256, pairwise overlap validated before any launch. Rejection queues no work; device launch failure poisons request.
api.budgets: No hidden scratch allocation: caller budgets all views; mix launches2 kernels, apply1. No allocation/copy/synchronization within execution.

reference.checked: All partials, own pre, post, combination matrices, carried/reset F32 collapsed outputs, both F16/F32 residual-apply outputs; every output bit exact, three repeats; input unchanged and guards intact.
reference.stress: Actual 80-site fn/base/scale source values; activations >FP16 range, tiny/subnormal values and signed zeros; alternating empty/nonempty carry; independent upstream compiled source reference frozen before port.
reference.synthetic: 20 independent original-kernel fixtures, D128/5120,R1/7/32/33/64, reset/carried; deliberately non-FP16-representable fn weights. Two concurrent requests sharing immutable weights, guarded buffers, invalid-plan rejection, plus three fully queued mix/apply sites with ping-pong carried-pre and no inter-site host fence.

fixture_extension.reason: Synthetic fn was extended with a non-FP16-representable 2^-29 offset, and a three-site asynchronously queued carry/apply chain was added. All final hashes come from the unchanged original GPU kernels; candidate output was never used to generate expected values.

profile.scope: Warmed HC4 carry mix (2 kernels) and F32 residual apply (1), actual layer0 attention raw F32 weights, R256 D5120,64 pairs. Model preparation and request allocation outside capture.

profile.limitations: One warmed operator shape; no full-layer/model throughput or vLLM parity claim. Context/module/library/driver memory is separate.

limitations: Batch row count controls both fn precision and reduction geometry. Qualification uses matched original R; arbitrary row-splitting is not numerically invariant.

HC4 operators are not yet wired into a complete native model forward/generation graph. Embedding+ExpandStreams, final HyperHead carry collapse, router/FFN composition, compressed/indexed attention/KV and Engram execution remain.

At R<=32 source uses cached FP16 fn; this implementation reads F32 fn then rounds. Same arithmetic, twice fn weight bytes compared with source FP16 layout. No decode-performance parity claim; optimize only after measurement.
Final HyperHead uses vendor torch.matmul carry collapse and needs separate independent qualification; do not replace it with the HCmix FMA loop.

One warmed R256,D5120 HC site/profile only. No full-layer/model throughput, cold offload, generation correctness or vLLM parity claim. CPU/Metal/new architecture coverage still requires the broader goal work.
